content.text: The line under the title says how long this page takes to read. On a wide screen, a list of its headings stands beside it and follows you as you scroll.
Hover over a heading and press the link icon beside it. That copies an address that jumps straight to the heading, and marks it for a moment.

Long pages need a little help. A reader who arrives here wants to know how long it will take, what is in it, and how to reach the part that matters. This text is here to make the page long enough to show that. Long pages need a little help.
